name: Uhldingen-Mühlhofen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Uhldingen-Mühlhofen (blue wavy bends between white roses on red).
history: The Ministry of the Interior granted the arms together with the flag on 16 August 1973.

features.role: Uhldingen-Mühlhofen arms — wavy bends and roses on red
